install: set -euo pipefail; npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; mkdir -p .tools; [ -x .tools/venv/bin/python ] || python3 -m venv .tools/venv; .tools/venv/bin/pip install --no-input -r tests/requirements.txt; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; line="export PATH=\"$PWD/.tools/venv/bin:$PWD/node_modules/.bin:\$PATH\""; grep -qxF "$line" "$HOME/.bashrc" || printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
